## What's New in v1.7

### New Features
- Guided onboarding for new users, with plain-language explanations when a connection fails
- Route map header on the main screen showing your connection path
- Network intelligence: smarter route and engine selection based on your network, operator and past connection quality
- New "Smart Net" diagram and expanded in-app guide

### Improvements
- More reliable automatic reconnect after the phone restarts
- Improved stability of the Xray and sing-box engines and their configuration handling
- Faster, more accurate server ping and subscription parsing
- Safer in-app updater: downloads are verified against a SHA-256 checksum
- Saved servers and settings are now stored with stronger encryption (existing data is migrated automatically)
- Android 16 (SDK 36) security review and hardening

### Fixes
- Live map now shows the verified exit location instead of a stale one

### Notes
- If you experience connection issues after updating, try switching engines from Settings
